name: Security of Network Services
description: Ensure that network services are identified, secured, and access to them is restricted using secure protocols.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules are documented and no overly permissive rules (ANY/wildcard) are present.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but contain overly permissive entries that need review.

missing_if.detail: No network rules uploaded to verify network service security.

remediation: Document all network services. Review and restrict firewall rules to least-privilege access.

name: Segregation in Networks
description: Ensure networks are segregated to reduce risks and limit the impact of security incidents.

compliant_if.detail: Network rules include explicit deny rules confirming network segmentation is in place.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but no explicit deny rules found — segmentation may be incomplete.

missing_if.detail: No network rules uploaded to verify network segmentation.

remediation: Implement network segmentation with default-deny policy between security zones.

name: Web Filtering
description: Ensure access to external websites is filtered to reduce exposure to malicious or inappropriate content.

compliant_if.detail: Network deny rules suggest web filtering or content restriction is active.

partial_if.detail: Network rules exist but no deny rules to confirm web content filtering.

missing_if.detail: No network rules uploaded to verify web filtering controls.

remediation: Implement web filtering to block malicious and inappropriate content. Document allowed categories.

name: Use of Cryptography
description: Ensure cryptographic controls are implemented to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity of information.

compliant_if.detail: Network and governance records confirm cryptographic controls and key management are documented.

partial_if.detail: Some evidence exists but cryptography policy is not fully documented across network and governance.

missing_if.detail: No network or governance records to verify cryptographic controls.

remediation: Define a cryptography policy covering encryption standards, key management, and certificate handling.
